nodes.label: Parties and recitals
nodes.description: The preamble that names the contracting parties, the effective date, and the background recitals (the whereas clauses) that explain the purpose.

nodes.label: Definitions
nodes.description: Clauses that define capitalized terms and rules of interpretation used throughout the agreement.

nodes.label: Scope and services
nodes.description: The clauses describing the work, services, products, or deliverables that a party is to provide and the standards for providing them.

nodes.label: Term
nodes.description: The clauses fixing the duration of the agreement, its effective period, and renewal or extension mechanics.

nodes.label: Payment
nodes.description: The clauses on fees, prices, invoicing, payment timing, expenses, taxes, and late-payment consequences.

nodes.label: Confidentiality
nodes.description: The clauses obliging the parties to protect each other's non-public information and limiting its use and disclosure.

nodes.label: Intellectual property
nodes.description: The clauses on ownership and assignment of, and licenses to, intellectual property such as inventions, work product, trademarks, and software.

nodes.label: Warranties
nodes.description: The clauses in which parties represent facts and promise quality or performance standards, together with disclaimers of other warranties.

nodes.label: Indemnification
nodes.description: The clauses requiring one party to compensate the other for specified third-party claims, losses, or damages.

nodes.label: Limitation of liability
nodes.description: The clauses capping or excluding damages and defining which types of loss each party cannot recover.

nodes.label: Termination
nodes.description: The clauses stating how and when either party may end the agreement early, for cause or convenience, and what happens afterwards.

nodes.label: Governing law and disputes
nodes.description: The clauses selecting the governing law, jurisdiction or venue, and dispute-resolution method such as arbitration or mediation.

nodes.label: General provisions
nodes.description: Boilerplate clauses such as notices, assignment, amendment, severability, entire agreement, force majeure, and counterparts.

nodes.label: Signatures and exhibits
nodes.description: The signature blocks and the attached schedules, exhibits, or annexes that complete the agreement.
